$comment: V9 acceptance scenario (INT-3, Milestone 2). Validate with node tests/scenarios/validate.mjs --dir tests/acceptance/scenarios-m2.
title: Weekly review automation: a repeatable workflow is proposed as one confirm card
refs: docs/05 §3.2 (a standing automation is never silent), §3.3 unattended asks are deferred
summary: The owner asks for a review every Friday at 4 PM. The assistant proposes it as one propose_automation confirm card (never the schedule tool); the owner confirms it. The fire path (the unattended Friday run) is covered by the daily/proactive workflow unit tests, not by this scenario.

setup.note: Google connector with the owner's matrix (calendar.read allow, gmail.send ask). Goals come from fixtures/goals.json.

scripted.note: Real agent loop, Permission Broker, audit and agent-core's propose_automation built-in. No fire path here: see the summary.

steps.title: A repeatable workflow is proposed as one automation confirm card (docs/05: persistent configuration is never silent); the schedule tool is not used
steps.text: Every Friday at 4 PM, review my week against my goals and suggest next steps. Don't change anything, just report.

runs.name: Weekly review
runs.prompt: Weekly review: compare this week's calendar with my active goals. For each goal, say what happened this week and how it compares with the goal's target or next milestone. Save the review as a Markdown artifact named weekly-review-<date> and summarize it here with up to three next steps. Do not create, move or send anything.
steps: Save the review as a Markdown artifact

turns.text: I've proposed a weekly review every Friday at 4:00 PM Pacific. Confirm the card to start it; the first run is this Friday.

assertions.note: The confirm card is the only way to create the run; propose_automation creates nothing itself.
docs/05 workflows: repeatable work becomes an automation via propose_automation, never via schedule (AUTOMATION_GUIDANCE).

steps.title: The owner confirms the card; the first run is this Friday at 4 PM Pacific

turns.text: Scheduled. I'll review your week every Friday at 4:00 PM Pacific, starting this Friday, October 23.
